note: Every clip is regenerated bit-for-bit by `python scripts/make_media.py` from these specs. 'universe' = random soup from a UniverseSpec; 'planted' = a hand-placed pattern (RLE) in an empty world. ids refer to the experiment exports in docs/data/experiments/.

items.title: Spiral and target waves (B2345678/S0158/C7)
items.caption: v0.1 run, universe #824. Excitable-medium spirals self-organise from noise (cf. Belousov-Zhabotinsky). Found by novelty search; seed-sensitive (spirals form in some seeds only).

items.title: Gliders with trails (B234567/S3568/C5)
items.caption: v0.1 run, universe #767. Many gliders with long refractory trails collide and build larger transient structures. Robust across 5 seeds in v0.1.

items.title: Evidence level 2: self-propelled shapes (B23567/S06/C7)
items.caption: R3 run, universe #1181. 13 of 13 candidate movers travel on their own in isolated clones. The long run ends in a period-96 cycle (= world size): movers circulating on the finite torus ('loops').

items.title: Striped medium with mobile defects (B23/S01237/C6)
items.caption: v0.2 run, universe #1029. Ordered stripes with defects that keep moving for 3200 steps. None of the defects is self-propelled in isolation: organisation that is distributed/contextual, which connected-component detection misses.

items.title: False positive caught: flickering foam (B1/S3468/C5)
items.caption: v0.1 ranked this 'complex' with 191 persistent shapes and a mover. In v0.2 the mover failed the isolated-clone test in every seed: a coincidence-driven false positive.

items.title: Transient trap: Life soup looks complex, then settles
items.caption: Conway's Life, 64x64, seed 2. Classified 'complex' at 500 steps; enters a cycle at t=719. Benchmark control showing why short horizons mislead.

items.title: Brian's Brain (B2/S/C3): known glider-rich rule
items.caption: Benchmark rule. 43-91 self-propelled shape types per run; innovation saturates early (new types stop appearing).

items.title: HighLife replicator in isolation (positive control)
items.caption: The replication probe's known positive: the pattern makes a growing number of exact copies of itself; random patterns of the same size do not.

items.title: Gosper glider gun (deceptive control for innovation)
items.caption: Active forever and full of movers, yet it produces the same glider forever: 'persists' passes it, the innovation probe correctly reports 0 new shape types.
